title: OISS v0.1 ShelfObservation data
description: What a shelf scan, shelf camera, audit or shelf label system found at one facing: on-shelf availability, planogram compliance and price integrity. subject is the facing id. A record carries status, tagPrice or both: a shelf label system knows the price a label shows but can't see the shelf.

allOf.description: A record reports on-shelf availability, a shelf tag price, or both.

status.description: On-shelf availability. Left out by sources that can't see the shelf, such as a shelf label system reporting a price check.

observedGtin.description: The item seen at the facing, if identified.

planogramGtin.description: The item the planogram assigns to the facing.

fillLevel.description: How full the facing is, from 0 (empty) to 1 (at capacity).

tagPrice.description: The price on the shelf tag or electronic shelf label.

systemPrice.description: The price in the retailer's price file or POS.
